_comment: Hand-written quiz questions (international cricket). gen_quiz.py merges these with questions computed from Cricsheet IPL data. Every number and claim here, hints and facts included, must be checked against a source (the linked Wikipedia page or ESPNcricinfo Statsguru) before it goes in. 'topic' (a string or a list) keeps related questions on different days and is stripped from the output.

questions.prompt: Who has scored the most runs in Test cricket?
questions.hint: Indian batter known as the Little Master

questions.prompt: How old was Sachin Tendulkar when he made his Test debut?
questions.hint: Still too young to vote
questions.fact: 16 years 205 days, against Pakistan in Karachi, November 1989

questions.prompt: Don Bradman walked out for his final Test innings needing how many runs to finish with a batting average of exactly 100?
questions.hint: A single boundary would have done it
questions.fact: He was bowled second ball for a duck by a googly in 1948, finishing on 99.94

questions.prompt: Who bowled Don Bradman for a duck in his final Test innings?
questions.hint: An English leg-spinner from Warwickshire
questions.fact: Bowled by a googly, second ball, in Bradman's final Test innings (1948)

questions.prompt: Bradman averaged 99.94. At that average, how many Test runs would he have scored if he'd been dismissed as often as Sachin Tendulkar (296 times)?
questions.hint: Nearly double Sachin's 15,921
questions.fact: 99.94 × 296 = 29,582. Bradman actually made 6,996 runs in 52 Tests

questions.prompt: Who has taken the most wickets in Test cricket?
questions.hint: Sri Lankan off-spinner
questions.fact: 800 wickets in 133 Tests, 1992–2010

questions.prompt: Muttiah Muralitharan took 800 Test wickets. On average, how many balls did he bowl for each one?
questions.hint: Less than ten overs' worth
questions.fact: 44,039 balls for 800 wickets: a wicket every 55 balls

questions.prompt: Who holds the record for the highest individual score in a Test innings?
questions.hint: West Indies left-hander who also made 375 against the same team
questions.fact: 400 not out against England in Antigua, 2004

questions.prompt: Brian Lara made 400 not out against England in 2004. How many balls did he face?
questions.hint: He batted for about 13 hours
questions.fact: 582 balls and 778 minutes, with 43 fours and 4 sixes

questions.prompt: In what year was the first ever Test match played?
questions.hint: Queen Victoria was on the throne
questions.fact: Australia v England at the MCG, March 1877. Australia won by 45 runs

questions.prompt: Jim Laker and Anil Kumble took all ten wickets in a Test innings. Who is the only other bowler to do it?
questions.hint: A Mumbai-born New Zealand spinner
questions.fact: 10 for 119 against India, December 2021

questions.prompt: In the 1956 Old Trafford Test, England's Jim Laker took how many of Australia's 20 wickets?
questions.hint: Almost all of them
questions.fact: Nineteen for 90, including all ten in the second innings (10 for 53): still a first-class record

questions.prompt: Rohit Sharma's 264 against Sri Lanka in 2014 is the highest ODI score. How many of those runs came in fours and sixes?
questions.hint: More than two-thirds of them
questions.fact: 33 fours and 9 sixes: 186 runs, off 173 balls in all

questions.prompt: India were 17 for 5 against Zimbabwe at the 1983 World Cup. How many did captain Kapil Dev score to rescue them?
questions.hint: It was an ODI record at the time
questions.fact: 175 not out off 138 balls at Tunbridge Wells. India won by 31 runs, and went on to win the Cup

questions.prompt: Who hit the six that won the 2011 World Cup final?
questions.hint: India's captain, who promoted himself up the order
questions.fact: Off Nuwan Kulasekara at the Wankhede, finishing on 91 not out

questions.prompt: Which team won the first T20 World Cup, in 2007?
questions.hint: They beat Pakistan in the final in Johannesburg
questions.fact: India beat Pakistan by 5 runs in the final

questions.prompt: Yuvraj Singh hit six sixes in an over at the 2007 T20 World Cup. Who was the bowler?
questions.hint: An English fast bowler who went on to take 600 Test wickets
questions.fact: Durban, September 2007. Yuvraj reached 50 off 12 balls

questions.prompt: Sachin Tendulkar scored 18,426 ODI runs. Leaving out boundaries, how many times did he run the length of the pitch?
questions.hint: Take away his 2,016 fours and 195 sixes
questions.fact: 9,192 runs run at 22 yards each is about 185 km, more than four marathons (ignoring all-run fours and overthrows)

questions.prompt: Muttiah Muralitharan took his 800th Test wicket with the last ball of his Test career. Who was the batter?
questions.hint: India's last man in
questions.fact: Muralitharan retired as the only bowler to reach 800 Test wickets

questions.prompt: Who bowled the 'Ball of the Century' to Mike Gatting in 1993?
questions.hint: An Australian leg-spinner, bowling his first ball in an Ashes Test
questions.fact: Old Trafford, 4 June 1993: it drifted outside leg stump and turned to clip the off bail

questions.prompt: Who was the first batter to pass 10,000 runs in Test cricket?
questions.hint: An Indian opener who played from 1971 to 1987
questions.fact: Widely regarded as one of the greatest opening batters of all time

questions.prompt: Which team won the first men's Cricket World Cup, in 1975?
questions.hint: They beat Australia in the final at Lord's
questions.fact: By 17 runs, in 60-over-a-side matches

questions.prompt: Who is the only bowler to take four wickets in four balls twice in international cricket?
questions.hint: A Sri Lankan fast bowler; the first time was against South Africa at the 2007 World Cup
questions.fact: He was also the first bowler to take two T20I hat-tricks

questions.prompt: Who made 201 not out to beat Afghanistan at the 2023 World Cup, after his team had slumped to 91 for 7?
questions.hint: An Australian all-rounder
questions.fact: Chasing 292 at the Wankhede, with 201 still needed when the seventh wicket fell

questions.prompt: Who scored 137 as Australia won the 2023 World Cup final against India?
questions.hint: He was out with Australia two runs from victory
questions.fact: Australia's sixth World Cup title, and Head was Player of the Final

questions.prompt: Who made the first double century in ODI cricket, men's or women's?
questions.hint: An Australian, playing against Denmark in 1997
questions.fact: 229 not out against Denmark at the 1997 Women's World Cup

questions.prompt: AB de Villiers hit the fastest ODI hundred. How many balls did he need?
questions.hint: Fewer than 40
questions.fact: Against West Indies in Johannesburg, January 2015, on his way to 149

questions.prompt: England made the highest ODI total, against the Netherlands in 2022. How many runs?
questions.hint: Their innings included a record 26 sixes
questions.fact: 498 for 4 in Amstelveen, June 2022

questions.prompt: What is the lowest total in Test cricket, made by New Zealand against England in 1954–55?
questions.hint: Fewer than 30
questions.fact: All out for 26 in Auckland. The next lowest is West Indies' 27 against Australia

questions.prompt: England won the 2019 World Cup final on boundary count after the match and the Super Over were both tied. How many boundaries did England hit?
questions.hint: New Zealand hit 17
questions.fact: 26 to 17: England's first men's World Cup

questions.prompt: Hanif Mohammad made 337 against West Indies at Bridgetown in 1957–58, after Pakistan followed on. Roughly how many hours did he bat?
questions.hint: Well over 900 minutes
questions.fact: 970 minutes. Still the highest score by a player in an away Test

questions.prompt: Wilfred Rhodes is the oldest man to play Test cricket. How old was he in his final Test, in 1930?
questions.hint: Older than 50
questions.fact: 52 years and 165 days. He'd made his England debut in 1899

questions.prompt: How many Test wickets did James Anderson take, the most by any fast bowler?
questions.hint: His international total across all formats was 991
questions.fact: 704 Test wickets; he played for England from 2002 to 2024

questions.prompt: Glenn Maxwell hit the fastest World Cup hundred, against the Netherlands in 2023. How many balls did it take?
questions.hint: It's the fourth-fastest hundred in all ODIs
questions.fact: 40 balls, at the 2023 World Cup

questions.prompt: Anil Kumble took all ten wickets in an innings against Pakistan in 1999. How many runs did he concede?
questions.hint: He did it in Delhi, in the second Test
questions.fact: 10 for 74, the second bowler after Jim Laker to take all ten

questions.prompt: How many international centuries did Sachin Tendulkar score across Tests and ODIs?
questions.hint: 51 of them came in Tests
questions.fact: 51 in Tests and 49 in ODIs: he's the only batter to make 100
